runState.description: WO-1074: 0x1001 is the inverter's OPERATING-STATE word - 1 forward, 2 reverse, 3 standby, 4 fault, 5 POFF. It was called "fault" until 2026-08-27, a label transcribed from the UCCNC modbus-master plugin ("VFD Error"); both were wrong. The fault rule below still tests THIS register for 4, which WO-1057 confirms is right. The real fault CODE is 0x5000 and is not read. DIRECTION WARNING (measured 2026-08-22, rotation verified by eye): on THIS machine 0x1001 reports the OPPOSITE direction to the one commanded - we write 1/Forward and it returns 2/Reverse, and the spindle physically turns clockwise, which is correct. NEVER INFER SPINDLE DIRECTION FROM THIS REGISTER; take it from what was commanded. The fault rule (equals 4) and the standby check (equals 3) are unaffected.
